verdict.rationale: Pendo publishes an llms.txt at developers.pendo.io that a probe confirmed returns HTTP 200, so an agent can be pointed at it. The sampled content is mostly product and keyword descriptions rather than developer reference, and the markdown-docs and OpenAPI probes returned 404, so its depth for agent use is unproven. missing for 10: evidence the llms.txt links to substantive developer/API documentation, markdown versions of docs pages, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
